principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class has multiple responsibilities: calculating the area and formatting output. This violates the Single Responsibility Principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the area calculation and output formatting into different classes. For instance, you could create an AreaOutputter class that handles the output logic.

principle_violations.reason: The logic for calculating the area of different shapes is repeated inside the sum method, violating the DRY principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Use polymorphism by creating an 'area' method in each shape class (Square and Circle) that returns its area. This way, you can call that method directly without needing to check the type in the AreaCalculator class.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
